scope: External staged Homes sign fixture, native Linux gl_compatibility with Dummy audio driver. Forced player/camera placement, not a natural gameplay run. No production changes.
observations: Unchanged verbose fixture clean once, resource warning reproduced on second execution; both exit0.
Repeated warning identifies AudioStreamWAV res://audio/ambience.wav and AudioStreamPlaybackWAV, each reference count1.
External drain variant waits0.5seconds then5physics frames after host.free; exited0 without resource warning once.
interpretation: Supports audio playback teardown timing as an explanation, not a proven root cause or proof that all production shutdowns are clean. Original warning remains valid; clean exit status alone does not mean warning-free.
prior_evidence: campaign/quality/nov6_scenery/README.md already notes active audio/ambience.wav playback identity.
